description: Telescopes whose bandwidth usage is exactly 47.6 are included, along with those above it.

b.request: Join telescopes to observatories on `observstation`, keep telescopes with `bandusagepct >= 47.6`, count telescopes for each `observstation` and `lunarstage` combination, order by count descending, and return the top 10 combinations.
b.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: Join telescopes to observatories on `observstation`, keep telescopes with `bandusagepct >= 47.6`, count telescopes for each `observstation` and `lunarstage` combination, order by count descending, and return the top 10 combinations.

a.request: Matching each telescope to its observatory by `observstation` (dropping telescopes with no matching observatory) and keeping only telescopes whose bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is at least 47.6, count the telescopes for each combination of observatory station and moon phase (`lunarstage`). List the station, the moon phase and the count, ordered by count from highest to lowest, and show only the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;

d.request: Join telescopes to observatories on `observstation`, exclude unmatched telescopes, keep those with `bandusagepct >= 47.6`, count telescopes by `observstation` and `lunarstage`, and return the station, moon phase, and count for the 10 groups with the highest counts.
d.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: Matching each telescope to its observatory by `observstation` (dropping telescopes with no matching observatory) and keeping only telescopes on the high side of a 47.6 cutoff for bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`), count the telescopes for each combination of observatory station and moon phase (`lunarstage`). List the station, the moon phase and the count, ordered by count from highest to lowest, and show only the top 10. Telescopes whose bandwidth usage is exactly 47.6 are included, along with those above it.
c.sql: SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
